title: Cell Biology (Obsidian fixture)
summary: A short intro-level cell biology course used as a test fixture. It follows how the mitochondrion makes energy and how plant and animal cells compare.

audience.notes: Written for a curious adult; no prior chemistry assumed.

steer.focus: How cells produce and use energy, and how cell types compare.

concepts.name: Cellular respiration
concepts.description: How cells release energy from food and capture it as ATP.
misconceptions: Respiration is the same thing as breathing

concepts.name: ATP synthesis
concepts.description: How the mitochondrion assembles ATP using a proton gradient.
misconceptions: ATP is stored in large amounts for later

concepts.name: Electron transport chain
concepts.description: The membrane complexes that pass electrons and pump protons.

concepts.name: Mitochondrion structure
concepts.description: The two-membrane layout of the mitochondrion and its folded inner membrane.
misconceptions: The mitochondrion has only a single membrane

concepts.name: Proton gradient
concepts.description: The stored energy held as a proton difference across the inner membrane.
misconceptions: Protons cross the inner membrane freely

concepts.name: Cytochrome c
concepts.description: The small mobile carrier that moves electrons between complexes.
misconceptions: Cytochrome c is a fixed part of one complex

concepts.name: Plant and animal cells
concepts.description: What plant and animal cells share and how they differ.
misconceptions: Plant cells have no mitochondria because they have chloroplasts

lessons.title: Energy in the cell
lessons.summary: How cells capture and spend energy, and how plant and animal cells compare.

steer.focus: Keep energy the through-line across both modules.

modules.title: Mitochondria and ATP
modules.summary: Where a cell makes most of its ATP and the machinery that does it.

steer.focus: Tie every part back to making ATP.

objectives.title: Introduction to energy production in the mitochondria
objectives.statement: The learner can explain how the mitochondrion converts food energy into ATP and analyse how its parts work together.

objectives.title: The electron transport chain
objectives.statement: The learner can describe how the electron transport chain moves electrons, pumps protons, and uses oxygen.

modules.title: Comparing cells
modules.summary: What plant and animal cells share and how they differ.

steer.focus: Compare structures by what each cell needs to live.

objectives.title: Plant and animal cells compared
objectives.statement: The learner can describe the shared parts of plant and animal cells and the features unique to plant cells.
